name: o2_glaive_rush_substitute
purpose: Glaive Rush into a Substitute (decision 0083 section 7): Raichu, p2a, sets up a Substitute at step 1 and Baxcalibur, p1a, breaks it with Glaive Rush; the null target still counts for selfDrops (data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:349-352, sim/battle-actions.ts:1317-1335), so the glaiverush volatile is set (-singlemove, silent). At step 2 Raichu's Thunderbolt hits Baxcalibur without an accuracy roll and with double damage (data/moves.ts:6659-6669). The engine did not set the volatile. The teams and the choices are written for this fixture (decision 0083 section 7); the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
